The '''Sleen''' was a slow and omnivorous [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]] native to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. A [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] scavenger, it preferred a damp and dark environment.<ref name="card">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Sleen}}</ref>

==Biology and appearance==
The bite of the sleen was deadly as the [[Bacteria/Legends|bacteria]] in its [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] caused near immediate gangrene and a normally fatal infection. It foraged the swamps and [[Forest/Legends|forests]] for food, usually [[Insect/Legends|insects]], and then went back to its hollowed out log or hole in the ground. The sleen often tracked disease weakened victims that survived its initial attacks until they expired in order to feed on the remains. The sleen near the [[Cave of Evil/Legends|Cave of Evil]] had adapted to take advantage of the disorientation experienced by potential prey in the area.<ref name="ff4">{{FactFile|4|DAG 1-4|Dagobah}}</ref>

[[File:Skrall.png|thumb|left|220px|[[Skrall|A sleen]] that escaped the [[Coronet Zoo]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] around [[3640 BBY]]. ]]
Larger, sleeker sleen were also known to have inhabited the [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] where they attacked unaware travelers due to their intensely territorial nature. Sleen were relatively minor predators in those jungles and generally fed upon the [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] of other lizard [[Species/Legends|species]] occasionally supplemented by hunting small live prey. Unlike the sleen of Dagobah, the Dromund Kaas sleen possessed webbed feet and were known to be one of the fastest creatures in the jungle. The ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of Dromund Kaas had used them as guard animals and pets until the practice grew untenable due to increasing population density and the difficulty of keeping sleen in small areas. However, in the later [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] the military elite still bred and maintained lineages of trained hunting sleen.<ref name="swtor" />

Populations of sleen were also found on [[Odessen]] and [[Nathema]]. On Odessen they were relatively tame and found in the vicinity of the [[Alliance base]]. These sleen were likely one of the several animal species transplanted to the world for study by Doctor [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] and his team.<ref name="kotfe">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref> On Nathema the sleen population was introduced when sleen kept in captivity for experimentation at the [[Sanitarium]] escaped after its destruction.<ref name="kotet">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The real-life counterpart for the sleen is a [[Wikipedia:Monitor lizard|Monitor Lizard]], more specifically a [[Wikipedia:Water Monitor|Water Monitor]]. A Water monitor was used to portray the species in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="familiar creatures">{{SW|url=news/drawing-from-the-present-familiar-creatures-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away|text=Drawing from the Present: Familiar Creatures in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref>
